caveats: QB injuries partially covered: 2026 production void filter + v2 QB feature failed walk-forward (market prices QB news fast; team pass EPA already contains QB signal). The untapped value is NON-QB positions.
One third-party note claims nflverse injury data unavailable after 2024 — unverified; 2021-2022 pull worked. Re-verify coverage for 2018-2020 and 2023-2025 before any experiment.
Questionable (the largest bucket, 3024 rows) is noisy — game-day actives/inactives decide. Preregister how Q is treated.
categories.leakage_risk: LOW, with discipline: use only report_status rows with date_modified before a defined prediction time (recommend Friday 12:00 ET to mirror the live pipeline). Do not use mid-week practice-status oscillations unless timestamped pre-prediction-time. Final Out/Doubtful is legitimate pregame truth, not leakage.
categories.source: nflverse load_injuries() — official weekly injury designations (practice participation + game status), 2009-present. VERIFIED working 2026-09-29: 11,269 rows for 2021-2022; report_status Out (1966) / Doubtful (322) / Questionable (3024); all positions (WR 1494, LB 1428, CB 1406, ... QB 431); date_modified UTC timestamps, zero nulls.
categories.timestamp_evidence: date_modified vs kickoff (2021 sample): median 28.3h pregame; 99.86% strictly pre-kickoff. Final designations are knowable before kickoff.
categories.why_it_matters: V1 knows 'how has this team performed' (with whoever played). The market knows 'who is actually playing today'. Fundamentally different information category from ELO/EPA — not another team-strength representation. Experiment 003's 0.985 V1-candidate error correlation shows representation tweaks are exhausted; this is the largest untested information gap.
